discovery.rule: Run the WPT manifest tool from the pinned commit over a working copy written from the pinned Git objects. Count the items of each manifest item type; each file entry contributes its array length minus one, because the first element is the file hash. Discovered tests are the items of every type except "spec" and "support".

tool.note: Placeholders name the local snapshot directories. The evidence log keeps the absolute command.
